summary: Short kerb on busy Swann Road in a bus zone, houses 5-9 m away.
reasons: Bus Zone signs on this kerb

best_section.where: North kerb of Swann Road, opposite the pedestrian refuge

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 5 m (at 5 m), 9 m (at 27 m) and 23 m back; walls and hedges on the kerb side.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb on the lane edge; a few cars stop here but there is no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Busy two-way arterial with buses and constant traffic.
drivers.convention: Bus Zone signs cover this kerb; no overnight parking convention.

flags: Bus Zone signs mark the kerb
sun_shade: Open to sky; houses and trees shade the kerb from the north.
